description.value: Built in 1940 as a hunting lodge, the Historic Chilcotin Lodge is one of the last remaining authentic frontier lodges in BC, located on the Chilcotin Plateau about 30 minutes west of Williams Lake along Highway 20. The lodge offers ten individually decorated rooms plus RV and tent camping, a fully licensed dining room, and a Burger Bar/Bakery café. It sits close to spectacular destinations including Farwell Canyon and Junction Sheep Range Provincial Park, and won the 2022 Tourism Excellence Award from the Williams Lake and District Chamber of Commerce.

address.value: 1080 Stack Valley Road, Riske Creek, BC V0L 1T0

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms this is an open, year-round historic lodge at 1080 Stack Valley Road, Riske Creek, with phone 1-250-659-5646 matching OSM. No mention of bike storage, bike procedures, laundry, Wi-Fi, or most other cyclist-specific amenities is found anywhere in the site content; the only cycling-adjacent reference is 'mountain bike' under general area activities. On-site evening food is confirmed via the licensed dining room described on the About Us and Dining pages, though the Burger Bar component is noted as closed for the season.
concerns: OSM name 'Chilcotin Lodge' differs from the business's own branding 'The Historic Chilcotin Lodge' used consistently across the website — consider updating the OSM record.
Burger Bar / Bakery Café is noted on the website as 'CLOSED FOR THE SEASON'; the main dining room remains available by reservation.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating, year-round lodge confirmed by a detailed website with current room rates and contact info; a clear and useful overnight stop for touring cyclists on Highway 20 through the Chilcotin.

Nearby evening food.detail: On-site licensed dining room serving gourmet meals; website says 'call to reserve your seat for Burgers or a Home-cooked Meal, during our normal dinner hour.' Burger Bar/Bakery is a second on-site option (seasonal)
